name: @galerina/devtools-naming
description: Naming standard enforcer for Galerina: detects abbreviations, implicit types, missing intent. Promotes Zero-Ambiguity / Maximum-Semantics coding.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs

note: Naming tooling ships independently of the compiler — naming conventions can be updated without waiting for compiler release cycles.
